title: Castawaves | KEY.co
description_expanded: Every home is well equipped with linens on each bed, as well as an extra set for any sleeper sofas that may be in the home. Each bathroom is stocked appropriately with bath towels, hand towels, wash cloths, and bath mats to accommodate the sleeping capacity of the home. There are starter sets of soap, detergent, dish soap, and toilet paper there for your convenience. Kitchens are each stocked with enough dishes, serving pieces, glassware, and all the other kitchen necessities to prepare meals during the guests stay. We provide a starter set of laundry detergent for our guests to use when they arrive. Bold, bright, and built to impress, this stunning new construction in Miramar Beach offers the ultimate vacation experience with resort-style amenities and sleek, modern design. Spanning three spacious stories with a private elevator and rooftop terrace, the home was made for entertaining—featuring a private pool and spa, a game room with arcade classics, and a luxe in-home theater with reclining seats. Inside, a crisp coastal aesthetic flows from room to room, with thoughtfully curated décor, natural light, and open-concept living spaces that make every gathering feel effortless.
